chunks: About a man who cultivates one hundred jaribs of land with his own seed, producing food or other things that are sown. Then another man comes to him and says: Take from me half of your seed and half of your expenses in this land so that I may become your partner.
He said: “There is no harm in that.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ: there is no harm in that; it is permissible
key_terms.لِأُشَارِكَكَ: so that I may enter into partnership with you
key_terms.مِائَةَ جَرِيبٍ: one hundred jaribs, a measure of cultivated land

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for someone to join a farming venture by paying half the seed and expenses?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting a partnership arrangement in cultivation after one party has begun with his own seed and expenses. It indicates that another person may join by contributing half the seed and half the expenses, and such an agreement is valid.
